report_name: ShinyHunters Hijacks Clop Ransomware Site in Inter-Gang Feud

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: An extortion group that hijacked and defaced the dark web data leak site of the Clop ransomware gang in retaliation for the alleged theft of a zero-day exploit ShinyHunters had developed. The group is known for data theft and extortion.

threat_actors.name: Clop
threat_actors.description: A notorious ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) gang whose dark web data leak site was hijacked by ShinyHunters. The group was accused of stealing and using a zero-day exploit developed by ShinyHunters.

attack_patterns.name: Internal Defacement
attack_patterns.description: ShinyHunters performed a web defacement of the Clop ransomware gang's dark web data leak site.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: ShinyHunters claimed to have exfiltrated sensitive operational data from the Clop leak site server, including Bitcoin transaction records and victim payment information.

malware.name: Clop
malware.description: The ransomware operated by the Clop gang, a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation whose extortion platform was compromised by ShinyHunters.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle E-Business Suite zero-day exploit
vulnerabilities.description: An alleged zero-day exploit for Oracle's E-Business Suite that ShinyHunters claims to have developed. Clop's alleged theft and use of this exploit was the stated reason for ShinyHunters' retaliation.

infrastructure.name: Clop Ransomware Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The dark web (Tor hidden service) data leak site operated by the Clop ransomware gang to publish stolen data and extort victims. This site was hijacked and defaced by ShinyHunters.

indicators.name: Tor (.onion) Domain DNS Query
indicators.pattern:
title: Tor (.onion) Domain DNS Query
id: 2b8a1c9e-5d4f-4e8a-9b1c-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries for .onion domains, which indicates the use of the Tor network. This can be a sign of malicious activity, as Tor is often used by threat actors for C2 communication or accessing dark web sites.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-22
references:
  - https://www.cybersecurity-insiders.com/why-ransomware-gangs-are-launching-cyber-attacks-on-each-other/
level: low
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith: '.onion'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries for .onion domains, which could indicate attempts to access dark web infrastructure like the Clop leak site.
